stages.headline: The perpendicular from point A to line a is the segment AH with AH ⊥ a, H on a; H is its foot.
stages.headlineEnglish: The perpendicular from point A to line a is the segment AH with AH ⊥ a, H on a; H is its foot.

stages.headline: Theorem: from a point not on a line exactly one perpendicular to the line can be drawn.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: from a point not on a line exactly one perpendicular to the line can be drawn.

stages.headline: The perpendicular from A to the line is shorter than any slanted segment (oblique) from A to the line.
